rows.asOfBasis: Latest actual rows in the HF dataset viewer, UTC snapshot date; not a README statistic
rows.evidence: Latest October 14 actual four shell rows sum to 11100; 10016 inferred operational, 1037 raising, 47 deorbiting. State subtotals agree. Viewer reports 8015 total rows. No shell-0 row at latest date; do not infer complete physical coverage. GCAT physical inventory is still October 13: dates differ, so no numeric discrepancy is calculated.
rows.versionCaveat: Viewer response is not a revision-pinned parquet download; repository revision and file hash describe repository metadata checked separately at retrieval.
rows.interpretation: Secondary coverage comparison only; page date may differ from catalogue epoch. Agreement is not proof, difference is not a verified inventory error.
rows.action: Retain provenance and date; no automatic inventory correction.
